(contains 'text=Lelang'). (3) Search 'Civic' (SOLD) -> sold-banner + sold-cta visible; save-calendar-button count = 0 and whatsapp-button count = 0 as required. Tapping interest-row-<id> navigates to /detail/<id> where interest-stats has all 4 boxes Dilihat/7 hari/Ketuk WA/WA 7 hari (values 49/1/24/1 observed). Clicking toggle-cat-<Ruko-id> triggers confirm dialog containing 'Nonaktifkan Kategori'; confirm-cancel dismisses and Ruko remains Aktif. Location filters, favorites and share (from iter 3) are unaffected.
action_items: None required for iteration 4 – all criteria met.

Optional cleanup: PUT /api/assets/{id} always appends a price_history entry even when the price is unchanged (see server.py L646). Restore-flow in tests therefore leaves one identical-price row in history. The catalog compute_price_meta() dedupes consecutive duplicates so it does NOT change penurunan_persen, but the raw history array grows over time. Consider skipping the $push when body.harga_limit == existing harga_limit.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1336 lines — router split is still recommended (auth/marketing/acrm/rcg/admin/public/catalog/track/wilayah/reports).
public_track increments stats without any rate-limit or client fingerprinting; a single client can inflate counters by reloading the page. Acceptable for demo, but note for prod.

calendar.ts uses expo-calendar which is fine; on web the Linking.openURL(gcal_url) works. On some browsers window.open may be blocked when triggered from an async handler after awaits — currently OK because openURL fires synchronously right after Platform.OS check.

manage.tsx renders one PROPERTI-level rename button whose row innerText includes ALL its children; testing/introspection can therefore accidentally target the parent. Non-blocking, but adding a distinct testID scope like rename-cat-parent-<id> vs rename-cat-sub-<id> would help future automation.
compute_price_meta returns penurunan_persen using int(round(...)) which can produce 10 for a 10% cut but rounds off cases like 9.5%. Acceptable, but document that it's an integer percentage.
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED one master_asset_category doc (TEST_KAT_X/Y) via teardown. Temporarily reduced then restored harga_limit on one MA-owned asset (id fetched dynamically). No demo assets modified permanently.

Price history is $push'ed on every PUT /api/assets/{id}. To find sub-category rename button by name in Kelola/Kategori tab, filter buttons whose closest ancestor innerText starts with '• <name>' — the parent PROPERTI row inherits the sub-labels.
rca_of_issue: No issues found. Two automation-only wrinkles: (1) `input[type='text']` matched the offscreen catalog-search-input on the login page — used placeholder-based selectors instead. (2) Selecting rename-cat by 'contains Ruko' matched the parent PROPERTI row because its innerText includes all children — filtered to ancestors whose innerText starts with the exact '• Ruko' bullet.
